mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_task(project_id, milestone_id, title, description, status, assignee_user_id, priority, due_date, block_reason, version, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{projectId}, #{milestoneId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{blockReason}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: t.id, t.project_id AS projectId, t.milestone_id AS milestoneId, m.name AS milestoneName, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, u.username AS assigneeName, t.priority, t.due_date AS dueDate, t.block_reason AS blockReason, t.version, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_task t LEFT JOIN lab_milestone m ON m.id=t.milestone_id AND m.project_id=t.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.assignee_user_id WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} AND t.id=#{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_task t WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId}
